text_block_list.text:
I pulled out my desk chair
to get some work done, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Popping up from under the desk: Ta-daaaa☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, I wanted to hang out with you, Trainer, so I was waiting for you~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Lately~ whether I'm hanging out with friends or racing,
I don't feel excited at aaall~..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But still,
I'm just not feeling that excitement yet...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sigh... Could it be that Maya's
in a slump when it comes to thrilling stuff~?

It seems fatigue is still lingering.
For the sake of her future success, should I reconsider her upcoming race schedule...?
